guidance.bestFor: The bare multi line box with placeholder text and no label, Field or hint around it
agentNotes: Only the `placeholder` names this `Textarea`, and it clears once typing starts; add a visible label as `c-textarea-3` does

whenNotToUse.when: A box drawn in its red error state after a failed check
A message box that carries its own Cancel and Post Comment buttons

guidance.bestFor: The red invalid state set by aria-invalid alone, with no label or message saying what is wrong
agentNotes: `aria-invalid` is fixed to true and no text says why; set it from your validation and print the reason under the box

whenNotToUse.when: A neutral box with no error to report yet
An error message printed under the box along with the red state

guidance.bestFor: A Your Message label above the box, tied to it by htmlFor and id, with nothing printed below

whenNotToUse.when: A label that also needs a line of help text under the box

guidance.bestFor: A Feedback label above the box and one line of help text printed below it
agentNotes: The `FieldDescription` hint says Enter sends, but no key handler exists, so Enter only adds a new line
`FieldDescription` is not tied to the `Textarea`; give it an id and list that id in aria-describedby

whenNotToUse.when: A labeled box with nothing printed under it

guidance.bestFor: A labeled box locked by the disabled attribute, dimmed to half opacity with a not allowed cursor
agentNotes: `Field` carries no data-disabled, so `FieldLabel` stays at full strength beside the dimmed box; give `Field` data-disabled true along with `disabled`
A `disabled` box is skipped by Tab and left out of form data; switch to readOnly when the text must still submit

whenNotToUse.when: A box the user can still type in, with its name shown above

guidance.bestFor: A 280 character Bio whose live count by the label turns to the warning tone 20 short of the cap and red at it
agentNotes: `handleChange` drops any edit that would pass `MAX_CHARS`, so a long paste is lost whole; set the maxLength attribute to cut it to fit
Height is set inline from `scrollHeight` only in `handleChange`, so clearing `value` from code leaves the box at its last height
`text-warning` needs a warning color in your theme; this item installs none, so near the cap the count falls back to the inherited text color

whenNotToUse.when: A character count kept in a row inside the border, under the text
